page.title: Frequently asked questions
page.text: Can't find your answer? Write to us and we'll get back to you soon.

whatFor.a: You share your schedule, meetups, Agenda (tasks, lists, routines) and projects with the people around you and talk about all of it in one place. Friends, team, family or partner; whoever you're planning with.

free.a: Yes. Schedule, meetups, the Agenda, projects (including guided tools and export for AI), chat and the couple space are free. Voice and video calls will come later with Pro: for one person, for two, or for up to five. What's free stays free.

iphone.a: For now it's only on Android.

web.q: Will I be able to use it on a computer?
web.a: A web version is planned; once it's ready you'll be able to use it in your browser with the same account. A desktop app for Windows is planned after that. For now the app is Android-only.

languages.a: Turkish and English. It opens in your phone's language and you can change it in Settings.

solo.q: Can I use it on my own?
solo.a: Yes; for your schedule, your Agenda, your routines and your projects. But it really shines once you add your people.

noPartner.q: Is it useful if I don't have a partner?
noPartner.a: Of course. Most of the app is for friend groups, teams and families. The couple space is an extra that only opens when you add someone as your partner.

difference.q: What's the difference between the Agenda and projects?
difference.a: The Agenda is for everyday things: groceries, chores, dated tasks and timed routines like medicine. Projects are for bigger things you do together: choosing a method, guided planning tools, roles, assigning work, approvals, a board and a timeline.

projectTools.q: Can it replace project management tools?
projectTools.a: For things you do with friends, at school or with a small team, yes: roles, approvals, a board, Gantt, critical path, task numbers, guided planning tools and export for AI are ready. It isn't built for big company processes. We describe what's planned for more professional use on the roadmap.

roadmap.a: Yes. A guided project start, nine planning tools (like SWOT → TOWS, Lean Canvas and MVP scope) and downloading your plan as a file you can give to an AI are now in the app. Next up are an income and expense plan and a "how do I get my app built?" guide; then the web and Windows apps, then a workspace for your clients and team. All planned, may change; we don't give dates. The income plan won't replace financial advice; it will remind you what to think about.

freelance.q: Can I use it with my clients as a freelancer?
freelance.a: Today you can only add your connections to a project, and a viewer sees the whole project, so there's no client-only view yet. A client space is on the roadmap: your client will see only what you share, make requests and sign off deliveries, and your notes to the team won't be visible to them.

visibility.a: No. You choose, person by person, who sees your schedule, your status and your tasks.

messagesSafe.a: Messages are stored encrypted on the server, and notification previews open only with your device's key. It isn't end-to-end encryption, and we say so plainly.

harassment.a: You can block and report them. Reports are reviewed and accounts can be restricted; nobody is told who reported them.

partnerSees.a: No. You both see the memories and plans in your shared space; for your schedule, status and tasks, you decide what to share.

breakup.q: What happens to the shared space if we break up?
breakup.a: It isn't deleted right away; it stays in a read-only archive for 30 days so you can download your memories. You can also delete it straight away with "Delete archive now".

longDistance.q: Does it work for long-distance couples?
longDistance.a: Yes. Photo days, the daily question and games you play at the same time all work from afar, and you can see your partner's local time. Voice and video calls are coming with Pro.

deleteData.a: Yes. In Settings → Account you can download your data or permanently delete your account.

age.q: How old do I need to be?
